description: SAMPLE ROW. Corrosion found around rivets on lower wing skin during annual inspection. Removed corrosion, treated and refinished.
SAMPLE ROW. Working rivets with dark staining and corrosion on stabilizer skin. Rivets replaced.
SAMPLE ROW. Wire bundle chafed through insulation at firewall pass-through. Repaired wires and replaced grommet.
SAMPLE ROW. Hydraulic fluid seeping at brake line fitting. Fitting replaced and leak checked.
SAMPLE ROW. Intermittent fault traced to corroded connector pins. Pins replaced, connector resealed.
SAMPLE ROW. Crack found at fastener hole on belly skin. Stop-drilled and doubler installed per repair data.
SAMPLE ROW. Filiform corrosion under paint along trailing edge of flap. Area stripped, treated and repainted.
